9000000000000000020.rules: Hybrid rules: 3 keepers (max 1 QB) plus 2 drafted rookies (max 1 QB), free. Taxi rookies carry over on their own. Run keeper.py for the recommendation. TWO-STAGE DRAFT: managers keep different numbers of players, so the commissioner runs a 10-round draft first and a second draft afterwards to fill rosters out. Finishing the first draft under capacity is EXPECTED, not a shortfall. TAXI RULE (user-supplied 8/13, SUPERSEDES the 8/11 text): the taxi squad is a ONE-YEAR ROOKIE REDSHIRT and it expires; a player parked last season is on the ACTIVE roster this season automatically, at no cost and with no activate-or-hold decision. ELIGIBILITY IS NARROW: only a rookie YOU DRAFTED THIS YEAR may occupy a seat — not a free agent, not a trade, not last year's rookie. A seat can therefore only ever be bought with one of your own picks, from EITHER draft. SEATS ARE OPTIONAL: they must be filled by the start of the season or they simply stay empty, and an empty seat costs nothing. (The 8/11 text claimed a seat left empty 'cannot be filled mid-season' and called taxi 'a DRAFT-DAY allocation'. Both were wrong.) WHAT THE SEAT IS WORTH: a taxi rookie carries into next season consuming NEITHER a keeper NOR a drafted-rookie slot — a free keeper, outside the 3+2 budget. THE PLAY IS NOT A LEFTOVER PICK: the user's own precedent is Jayden Daniels — stash a rookie good enough to START, pay one season of his production, own him next year for free. A rookie still on the board in the last rounds of draft 1 is by definition one the room does not rate, which is exactly the player not worth a free keeper. Advice to 'spend the last picks on redshirts' inverts this and is wrong. SEQUENCING: a rookie who will last until draft 2 should be taken THERE, since those picks are near-free; spend a draft-1 pick only on a rookie who will not last. DRAFT 2 MECHANICS (user-supplied 8/13): its length is set by the team with the GREATEST need and every team drafts that many rounds; teams needing fewer bodies have their surplus picks filled by the commissioner with retired or zero-value players, which each manager immediately drops so all rosters end level. PRACTICAL EFFECT: draft 1 carries NO obligation to fill roster slots — anything you skip is filled later at negligible cost. Draft 1 is a pure value auction and positional need should carry very little weight in it.

9000000000000000010.rules: LG01 is full dynasty. The whole roster carries over each year and future drafts are rookies and free agents only, so there is no keeper decision to make. Every add or trade sticks with you past this season, so weigh age and future value alongside this year's points. TAXI (3 seats): taxi players do NOT consume an active roster spot and carry into next season free -- they are free bets on youth, not bench competition. So the bench and the taxi are different jobs: bench spots hold players who can help THIS season or hold trade value, taxi holds players who will not play in 2026. Taxi-profile players last deep into the draft (nobody drafts a redshirt), so spend mid picks on active-roster value and take the free bets in the final rounds. TAXI RULE: the 8/11 paragraph that used to sit here was copied from the Hybrid leagues and its specifics were CORRECTED on 8/13 for those leagues only — the corrections have NOT been confirmed for this league. Do not assume they carry over. Two Hybrid facts that are known not to generalise: the free-keeper prize does not exist here (full dynasty, the whole roster carries over, so a taxi seat buys storage rather than a keeper exemption), and this league has no second draft to defer a rookie into. The native guidance above — late-round free bets on youth — remains the operative advice here. CONFIRM WITH THE COMMISSIONER before applying Hybrid taxi reasoning to this league.

9000000000000000018.rules: LG04 is a 2026 startup, so nobody keeps anyone this year. Starting in 2027 you keep one player, and it costs the round he was drafted the season before. That makes late-round hits on Sep 6 worth extra: a 12th-round steal is also next year's cheap keeper. Run 'python keeper.py lg04' next offseason.

_room_shave_note: room_shave: picks to subtract from ADP when estimating whether a player survives to your next pick. It is a property of the ROOM, not of the market, so it is per-league data and never a default. LG01 buys veterans about 10 picks early and has done so consistently (CLAUDE.md lesson 6). Both Hybrids are 0 — user, 8/11: 'these guys know what they're doing, for the most part.' Once a draft has picks on the board, room_bias.py measures this instead of assuming it; these numbers are the pre-draft prior.

9000000000000000022.rules: LG06 -- 10 teams, REDRAFT (settings.type 0), no keepers, no taxi, 16 rounds, plain snake, FAAB 100, playoffs start week 15. Draft Wed Sep 9 2026, 5:00 PM PT; draft_order was still NULL as of 8/13 so the slot is unknown -- do not guess it. Starters: QB RB RB WR WR TE FLEX K DL LB DB (11) plus 5 bench = 16, which is exactly the round count. Every pick is a roster spot; there is nowhere to stash and nothing spare to cut. IDP, and the scoring is not a normal one. idp_sack 10, idp_int 10, idp_def_td 10, idp_ff 5, idp_fum_rec 5, idp_pass_def 2, idp_safe 2. Critically idp_tkl is 1.0 and idp_tkl_ast is ALSO 1.0 while idp_tkl_solo is 0.0 -- assisted tackles count full. IDP, AND POINTS ARE NOT THE SAME AS VALUE HERE -- this was got wrong twice before the VORP board settled it (8/13). Linebackers SCORE the most: 8 of the top 10 projected defenders are LB and the best paces ~270, because idp_tkl_ast counts full so combined-tackle volume is steady income, while a 15-sack season is only 0.88 sacks a week. But LB is 80 deep against 10 starting slots (8.0x) and DL is 20 deep against 10 (2.0x), so replacement level sits at LB10 = 220 and DL10 = 161. The best DL is worth MORE than the best LB despite scoring 40 fewer points: Hutchinson +69 VORP against Campbell +50. DRAFT DL EARLY, LB AND DB LATE. DL is the scarcest position in the league by depth ratio, ahead even of RB. IDP players carry NO ADP in any Sleeper market, so every survival call on the DL/LB/DB board is blind -- the 'gone by your next turn' flags cannot work there. Only 293 of 2111 rostered defenders carry any projection at all; past that the cliff is absolute. OFFENCE IS ALSO EXTREME: every touchdown is 10 points (pass, rush, rec), full PPR, pass_yd 0.05, rush/rec_yd 0.1, no first-down or TE bonuses. Turnovers bite: pass_int -5, pass_int_td -5, fum_lost -5, so a 15-INT quarterback hands back 75 points. Touchdown dependence and interceptions separate players more than yardage does. Rough season pace: elite QB ~580, elite RB ~370, elite WR ~340, elite TE ~270, best LB ~279, volume LB ~200, 15-sack DL ~229, coverage DB ~165. One QB starts, so ten are needed. Josh Allen projects 785 -- the largest number on the board by 250 points -- and is worth only +106 VORP, because 32 quarterbacks remain for 10 slots and replacement is 679. The biggest number is not the biggest edge. WAIT ON QB. Value concentrates at RB (Gibbs +219, Bijan +208) and at the top of TE (Bowers +99). USE `draft_helper.py board`, NOT `lineup_value.py`: this is a redraft league, the roster is empty until draft day, and marginal value against an empty lineup collapses to raw projection and recommends six quarterbacks.
